proseRules.guideline: Most sentences under 25 words. Break any longer.
Aim for a Flesch Reading Ease of 55-70 (plain English for a student). Avoid jargon; when a term is necessary, define it in parentheses.
Active voice. The subject acts, not is-acted-upon.
Contractions are fine (you'll, don't, it's). They read more human.
Concrete, student-relatable examples over abstract claims.

renderingRules.guideline: Body is Markdown. One H1, H2s per section. Tables use pipe syntax. Code in fenced blocks.
Use the suggested internal links verbatim; do not invent new Nomi slugs.
Only cite real, authoritative URLs. If you cannot verify one, omit the external reference.
